code: import os import json import time import random from datetime import datetime from urllib.parse import urljoin from bs4 import BeautifulSoup from playwright.sync_api import sync_playwright # ================= 配置区域 ================= # 爬取时间范围（严格按照用户指定） START_DATE = "2025-12-01" END_DATE = "2025-12-31" # 输出目录 OUTPUT_DIR = r"d:\llm_mcp_genpy\pygen\output" # 目标URL BASE_URL = "https://www.chinabond.com.cn/xwgg/ggtz/xwgg_gsgg/gsgg_zytz_ath/" # =========================================== def clean_html_content(html_content, base_url): """ 将 HTML 中的相对路径转换为绝对路径 这是必须的步骤，否则本地预览时图片无法显示 """ if not html_content: return "" try: soup = BeautifulSoup(html_content, 'html.parser') # 修复图片链接 for img in soup.find_all('img'): if img.get('src'): img['src'] = urljoin(base_url, img['src']) # 修复超链接 for a in soup.find_all('a'): if a.get('href'): a['href'] = urljoin(base_url, a['href']) return str(soup) except Exception as e: print(f"内容清洗出错: {e}") return html_content def parse_date(date_str): """解析日期，支持多种格式，统一返回 YYYY-MM-DD""" if not date_str: return "" date_str = date_str.strip() # 常见日期格式 formats = ["%Y/%m/%d", "%Y-%m-%d", "%Y.%m.%d", "%Y年%m月%d日"] for fmt in formats: try: return datetime.strptime(date_str, fmt).strftime("%Y-%m-%d") except ValueError: continue return date_str def extract_content(page_content, base_url): """ 从详情页HTML中提取正文 使用启发式策略，适配不同类型的详情页结构 """ soup = BeautifulSoup(page_content, 'html.parser') # 移除无用元素 for tag in soup(['script', 'style', 'iframe', 'noscript']): tag.decompose() # 尝试常见的正文选择器（根据中国债券信息网及常见政府网站结构） selectors = [ ".TRS_Editor", ".article-content", "#content", ".content", ".detail_content", "div.xl_content", ".news_content" ] content_html = "" for selector in selectors: element = soup.select_one(selector) if element: content_html = str(element) break # 如果没找到明确的容器，尝试找字数最多的 div if not content_html: divs = soup.find_all("div") max_len = 0 best_div = None for div in divs: # 计算纯文本长度 text_len = len(div.get_text(strip=True)) # 排除包含大量链接的导航栏等 link_density = len(div.find_all('a')) / (text_len + 1) if text_len > max_len and link_density < 0.1: max_len = text_len best_div = div if best_div and max_len > 50: # 至少有点内容 content_html = str(best_div) return clean_html_content(content_html, base_url) def crawl_news(): articles = [] with sync_playwright() as p: # 启动浏览器，配置反爬参数 browser = p.chromium.launch( headless=True, args=["--disable-blink-features=AutomationControlled", "--no-sandbox"] ) context = browser.new_context( viewport={'width': 1920, 'height': 1080}, user_agent="Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/120.0.0.0 Safari/537.36", extra_http_headers={"Accept-Language": "zh-CN,zh;q=0.9,en;q=0.8"} ) page = context.new_page() print(f"开始访问: {BASE_URL}") try: page.goto(BASE_URL, wait_until="networkidle", timeout=60000) except Exception as e: print(f"页面加载超时或失败: {e}") return articles page_num = 1 has_next = True while has_next: print(f"--- 正在分析第 {page_num} 页 ---") # 等待列表元素加载 try: page.wait_for_selector("div.rightListContent", timeout=10000) except: print("未找到列表元素，可能已无数据或加载失败") break # 解析当前页列表 html = page.content() soup = BeautifulSoup(html, 'html.parser') items = soup.select("div.rightListContent") if not items: print("当前页无数据") break page_articles = [] stop_crawling = False # 停止翻页标志 for item in items: try: # 提取日期 date_node = item.select_one("span.rightListTime") raw_date = date_node.get_text(strip=True) if date_node else "" date = parse_date(raw_date) # 提取链接和标题 link_node = item.select_one("span.rightListImport a") if not link_node: continue title = link_node.get_text(strip=True) relative_link = link_node.get('href') full_link = urljoin(BASE_URL, relative_link) # 日期过滤逻辑 if not date: # 如果没有日期，通常跳过或作为补充数据，这里选择跳过 continue if date > END_DATE: # 日期太新，继续查找下一条 continue if date < START_DATE: # 日期早于开始时间 # 假设列表是按时间倒序排列的，一旦遇到早于开始时间的记录，说明后面的更早，可以停止翻页 print(f"发现日期 {date} 早于开始时间 {START_DATE}，停止翻页") stop_crawling = True break # 符合条件，加入待爬取列表 print(f"[发现目标] {date} {title}") page_articles.append({ "title": title, "date": date, "sourceUrl": full_link, "source": "中国债券信息网", "author": "中国债券信息网" }) except Exception as e: print(f"解析列表项出错: {e}") continue # 抓取本页符合条件的文章详情 for article in page_articles: print(f"正在抓取详情: {article['title']}") try: # 打开新页面抓取详情 detail_page = context.new_page() # 增加重试机制 for retry in range(2): try: detail_page.goto(article['sourceUrl'], wait_until="domcontentloaded", timeout=30000) break except: if retry == 1: raise time.sleep(2) # 提取正文 content = extract_content(detail_page.content(), article['sourceUrl']) article['content'] = content # 提取摘要（前200字） soup_detail = BeautifulSoup(content, 'html.parser') article['summary'] = soup_detail.get_text(strip=True)[:200] + "..." detail_page.close() articles.append(article) # 随机延时，避免请求过快 time.sleep(random.uniform(1, 2)) except Exception as e: print(f"抓取详情失败: {e}") # 即使详情失败，也保留基本信息 article['content'] = f"抓取失败: {str(e)}" articles.append(article) if stop_crawling: break # --- 翻页逻辑 --- try: # 定位下一页按钮 # 根据页面结构： next_btn = page.locator(".pageNext") # 检查按钮是否存在且可见 if next_btn.count() > 0 and next_btn.is_visible(): # 尝试点击并等待导航 try: with page.expect_navigation(timeout=10000): next_btn.click() page_num += 1 time.sleep(2) # 等待页面渲染 except Exception as nav_err: # 如果超时，可能是已经是最后一页，或者页面通过AJAX刷新 # 检查URL是否变化或页面内容是否更新 print(f"翻页点击后未检测到标准导航，尝试继续分析页面: {nav_err}") # 如果页面内容没变，可能真的到底了 has_next = False else: print("未找到下一页按钮或已到最后一页") has_next = False except Exception as e: print(f"翻页过程出错: {e}") has_next = False browser.close() return articles def save_results(articles: list, output_path: str): """保存结果为 JSON""" result = { "total": len(articles), "crawlTime": datetime.now().strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S"), "dateRange": f"{START_DATE} to {END_DATE}", "articles": articles } try: with open(output_path, 'w', encoding='utf-8') as f: json.dump(result, f, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) print(f"成功保存 {len(articles)} 条新闻到 {output_path}") except Exception as e: print(f"保存文件失败: {e}") def main(): # 确保输出目录存在 if not os.path.exists(OUTPUT_DIR): os.makedirs(OUTPUT_DIR, exist_ok=True) print(f"=== 启动爬虫 ===") print(f"目标网站: 中国债券信息网-重要通知") print(f"时间范围: {START_DATE} 至 {END_DATE}") articles = crawl_news() # 生成文件名 timestamp = datetime.now().strftime("%Y%m%d_%H%M%S") filename = f"chinabond_news_{timestamp}.json" output_path = os.path.join(OUTPUT_DIR, filename) save_results(articles, output_path) print("=== 爬取结束 ===") if __name__ == "__main__": main()
